set -a; . "$HOME/.config/jarvis/env"; set +a J="$HOME/.config/jarvis"; LOCK="$J/poll.lock"; LOG="$J/logs/poll.log"; WM="$J/last_seen_ts" REPO="$HOME/github.com/tazgreenwood/private-dotfiles" CAP="${JARVIS_DAILY_USD_CAP:-2.00}" RUN_CAP="${JARVIS_RUN_USD_CAP:-0.50}" t() { date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ; } # Bound the log in place (launchd holds the fd, so truncate — never mv). if [ -f "$LOG" ] && [ "$(wc -c < "$LOG" | tr -d ' ')" -gt 5242880 ]; then : > "$LOG"; echo "$(t) log truncated at 5MB"; fi mkdir "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || { echo "$(t) skip: previous tick still running"; exit 0; } trap 'rmdir "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null' EXIT [ -n "$SLACK_BOT_TOKEN" ] || { echo "$(t) fatal: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN unset in $J/env"; exit 1; } [ -n "$CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN" ] || { echo "$(t) fatal: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN unset in $J/env"; exit 1; } # Reading a PRIVATE channel's history needs groups:history. Prefer a user token # when one is configured; otherwise use the bot token. READ_TOKEN="$SLACK_BOT_TOKEN"; READ_AS="bot" [ -n "$SLACK_USER_TOKEN" ] && { READ_TOKEN="$SLACK_USER_TOKEN"; READ_AS="user"; } R="$REPO/claude/mcp/server/registry" RES=$(printf '%s
%s
' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2024-11-05","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"jarvis-poll","version":"1"}}}' '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"registry_get_resources","arguments":{"name":"private-dotfiles","category":"slack"}}}' | "$R" 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | jq -r '.result.content[0].text // empty') CH=$(printf '%s' "$RES" | jq -r '.resources.slack.jarvis_channel // empty') WHO=$(printf '%s' "$RES" | jq -r '.resources.slack.jarvis_user_id // empty') [ -n "$CH" ] && [ -n "$WHO" ] || { echo "$(t) fatal: registry gave no jarvis_channel/jarvis_user_id"; exit 1; } H=$(curl -sS --max-time 30 "https://slack.com/api/conversations.history?channel=$CH&limit=30" -H "Authorization: Bearer $READ_TOKEN") if [ "$(printf '%s' "$H" | jq -r '.ok')" != "true" ]; then E=$(printf '%s' "$H" | jq -r '.error // "unparseable"') case "$E" in missing_scope|not_in_channel|channel_not_found|invalid_auth|account_inactive) echo "$(t) unconfigured: slack read as $READ_AS denied ($E) — no agent spawned, cost 0.00" echo "$(t) REMEDIATION (pick one): (a) add the groups:history scope to the aiportal Slack app and reinstall it, then retry; or (b) append SLACK_USER_TOKEN=<a user token holding groups:history> to $J/env." exit 0 ;; *) echo "$(t) fatal: slack read failed: $E"; exit 1 ;; esac fi MAXTS=$(printf '%s' "$H" | jq -r '([.messages[]? | (.ts // "0"), (.latest_reply // "0")] | max) // "0"') WMV=$(cat "$WM" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]') if [ -z "$WMV" ]; then printf '%s' "$MAXTS" > "$WM"; chmod 600 "$WM" echo "$(t) tick: watermark initialised at $MAXTS (read as $READ_AS), no backlog escalation, cost 0.00" exit 0 fi # New == authored by the human after the watermark, or a thread whose newest # reply is after the watermark and which the human has replied in. N=$(printf '%s' "$H" | jq --arg u "$WHO" --arg wm "$WMV" '[.messages[]? | select((((.user // "") == $u) and ((.ts // "0") > $wm)) or (((.latest_reply // "0") > $wm) and (((.reply_users // []) | index($u)) != null)))] | length') # Advance unconditionally: a message that has been considered once must never be # able to re-trigger an escalation on every subsequent tick. NEWWM=$(printf '%s
%s
' "$WMV" "$MAXTS" | sort | tail -1) printf '%s' "$NEWWM" > "$WM"; chmod 600 "$WM" if [ "$N" = "0" ]; then echo "$(t) tick: quiet (read as $READ_AS, watermark $NEWWM), no agent spawned, cost 0.00" exit 0 fi DAY=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d); LEDGER="$J/spend-$DAY.txt" SPENT=$(cat "$LEDGER" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -n "$SPENT" ] || SPENT=0 if [ "$(awk -v s="$SPENT" -v c="$CAP" 'BEGIN{print (s+0 >= c+0) ? 1 : 0}')" = "1" ]; then echo "$(t) tick: $N candidate(s) but daily cost cap reached (spent \$$SPENT of \$$CAP) — escalation suppressed, cost 0.00" exit 0 fi echo "$(t) tick: $N candidate(s) past watermark $WMV, escalating (per-run cap \$$RUN_CAP; spent \$$SPENT of \$$CAP today)" cd "$REPO" || exit 1 O=$(claude -p '/jarvis poll' --permission-mode dontAsk --max-budget-usd "$RUN_CAP" --output-format json 2>&1) COST=$(printf '%s' "$O" | jq -r '.total_cost_usd // 0' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$COST" ] || COST=0 awk -v s="$SPENT" -v c="$COST" 'BEGIN{printf "%.4f", s+0+c+0}' > "$LEDGER"; chmod 600 "$LEDGER" find "$J" -maxdepth 1 -name 'spend-*.txt' -mtime +7 -delete 2>/dev/null || true echo "$(t) run: subtype=$(printf '%s' "$O" | jq -r '.subtype // "unparsed"' 2>/dev/null) cost=$COST day_total=$(cat "$LEDGER")"
